work_title: Example of a Bitcoin transaction parsing in ErgoScript
description: Merged upstream: sigmastate-interpreter#1177, merged by kushti into ergoplatform:v6.0.6 on 2026-07-29, and issue #1114 is now closed. Work: an ErgoScript contract parsing a real Bitcoin transaction, plus 10 tests. Correcting my own correction: on 2026-08-11 I reverted this to in-progress believing the PR was still open, when it had already been merged for two weeks. The merge targeted the v6.0.6 release branch rather than master, which is where these repositories take this kind of change.
